device_type.instructions: Which kind of device sends readings with these names and units?

criteria.environment: air or soil conditions: temperature, humidity, CO2, light, particles
criteria.energy: electricity: voltage, current, power, energy, kWh
criteria.vibration: machine condition: vibration, acceleration in g, velocity in mm/s, rpm, spectrum
criteria.flow_pressure: fluids in pipes: flow rate, pressure in bar or psi
criteria.level: tank, silo or water level, distance to a surface, fill %
criteria.location: GPS tracker: latitude, longitude, satellites, speed, heading
criteria.vision: camera or vision model: labels, detections, confidence scores, frames
criteria.unknown: only generic names such as value, status, data or uptime

description: DRAFT, not shipped: it fails its gates on the base checkpoints (system1.md §16). Readings of a newly seen device, as names and units, never the device id. State: {readings}.
